description: This file defines an API client for interacting with device-related endpoints, including functions for listing, fetching, creating, updating, deleting, and checking device status. It also re-exports an IPv4 validation function.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request and handles JSON response, returning data or error.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Fetches a list of devices with optional client-side sorting and filtering.

methods.name: fetchDevices
methods.description: Fetches devices with optional server-side search and sort parameters.

methods.name: createDevice
methods.description: Creates a new device with provided input data.

methods.name: getDevice
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific device by ID.

methods.name: updateDevice
methods.description: Updates an existing device identified by ID with new data.

methods.name: pingDevice
methods.description: Sends a ping request to a device to check its status.

methods.name: getDeviceStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a device.

methods.name: isValidIPv4
methods.description: Validates whether a string is a valid IPv4 address.
